description: How does a declared parameter behave when it is assigned Null, assigned Empty, assigned the empty string (Text only) or left unassigned: projected as itself, in p + 1, Nz, (x = p), (p Is Null), p & 'a', Len(p) and LIKE; and for the WHERE forms x = p, x <> p, p Is Null, x NOT IN (p, 1) and x BETWEEN p AND 2 with p Null? Per temporary QueryDef: Parameters (Name, Type, Direction, Value), an open with nothing assigned, then an open after each assignment (Fields Name/Type/Size, rows, Errors). Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text goes into a temporary QueryDef (CreateQueryDef with an empty name, then DBEngine.Errors).
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-13b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
